name: MoYu Cube Mosaic Art Gallery 3x3 (5.5cm)
description: The MoYu Cube Mosaic Art Gallery 3x3 is a set of 9 55mm 3x3s that you can use to build and display all different kinda of mosaics. It comes with a holder/display case, a pamphlet to give you ideas, and two adhesive wall mounts. Let your creativity show with the MoYu Cube Mosaic Art Gallery!
